```{r setup, message=FALSE, warning=FALSE, include=FALSE}
library(tidyverse)
library(R2jags)
library(coda)
library(patchwork)

main_path <- getwd()
data_path <- file.path(main_path, "data/cleaned_data")
study_2_path <- file.path(main_path, "study_2")
results_path <- file.path(main_path, "results")
models_path <- file.path(main_path, "models")
figure_path <- file.path(study_2_path, "figures")

set.seed(7386)

demographics <- read_csv(file.path(data_path, "demographics.csv"), show_col_types = FALSE)
roundwise_clean <- read_csv(file.path(data_path, "roundwise_clean.csv"), show_col_types = FALSE)
source(file.path(main_path, "overall_functions.R"))

```

```{r}
#analytic sample
dem_solo_analytic <- demographics %>%
  filter(
    setup == "SOLO",
    !excluded,
    !participant.code %in% c("l6gxo7po", "n0ndmyka")) # Two participants excluded due to technical errors

solo_ids <- dem_solo_analytic %>%
  distinct(id)

solo_rounds <- roundwise_clean %>%
  filter(!excluded, setup == "SOLO") %>%
  semi_join(solo_ids, by = "id")
```

```{r}
# Derive duration and sound-condition variables
solo_rounds <- solo_rounds %>%
  mutate(
    gender = factor(gender, levels = c("Female", "Male")),
    completed = as.integer(completed),
    secs = as.numeric(secs),
    log_secs = log(secs + 1),
    any_sound = as.integer(replace_na(any_stimulus, FALSE)),
    sound1_lower = str_to_lower(coalesce(sound1_stimulus, "")),
    sound2_lower = str_to_lower(coalesce(sound2_stimulus, "")),
    sound3_lower = str_to_lower(coalesce(sound3_stimulus, "")),
    any_cry = as.integer(
      str_detect(sound1_lower, "cry|cries") |
        str_detect(sound2_lower, "cry|cries") |
        str_detect(sound3_lower, "cry|cries")),
    any_alarm = as.integer(
      str_detect(sound1_lower, "alarm") |
        str_detect(sound2_lower, "alarm") |
        str_detect(sound3_lower, "alarm")),
    round_sound_type = case_when(
      any_sound == 0 ~ "none",
      any_cry == 1 & any_alarm == 0 ~ "cry_only",
      any_cry == 0 & any_alarm == 1 ~ "alarm_only",
      any_cry == 1 & any_alarm == 1 ~ "mixed_cry_alarm"),
    round_sound_type = factor(
      round_sound_type,
      levels = c(
        "none",
        "alarm_only",
        "cry_only",
        "mixed_cry_alarm"))) %>%
  filter(round_sound_type != "mixed_cry_alarm") %>%
  droplevels()
```

```{r}
duration_df <- solo_rounds %>%
  filter(
    completed == 1,
    round_sound_type %in% c("none", "alarm_only", "cry_only"),
    !is.na(log_secs),
    !is.na(gender),
    !is.na(participant.code)) %>%
  droplevels() %>%
  mutate(
    gender = relevel(gender, ref = "Female"),
    round_sound_type = relevel(
      round_sound_type,
      ref = "none"))
```

```{r}
# Raw and log-transformed answered-round duration distributions

duration_dist_df <- duration_df %>%
  dplyr::select(
    secs,
    log_secs) %>%
  pivot_longer(
    cols = c(
      secs,
      log_secs),
    names_to = "scale",
    values_to = "duration") %>%
  mutate(
    scale = factor(
      scale,
      levels = c(
        "secs",
        "log_secs"),
      labels = c(
        "Raw round duration",
        "Log-transformed round duration")))

p_duration_distributions <- ggplot(
  duration_dist_df,
  aes(x = duration)) +
  geom_histogram(
    bins = 30) +
  facet_wrap(
    ~ scale,
    scales = "free_x",
    ncol = 2) +
  labs(
    x = NULL,
    y = "Count") +
  theme_minimal(base_size = 12) +
  theme(
    panel.grid.minor = element_blank(),
    strip.text = element_text(face = "bold"))

show_or_save_ggplot(
  plot_png_path = file.path(
    figure_path,
    "s2_duration_raw_log_distributions.png"),
  plot_object = p_duration_distributions,
  width = 10,
  height = 5,
  dpi = 300)
```

# Check original factor coding
duration_df %>%

duration_df %>%

duration_df %>%

duration_model_df <- duration_df %>%
  mutate(
    gender_num = if_else(gender == "Male", 1L, 0L),
    sound_num = case_when(
      round_sound_type == "none" ~ 1L,
      round_sound_type == "alarm_only" ~ 2L,
      round_sound_type == "cry_only" ~ 3L),
    participant_id = as.integer(factor(participant.code)))

# Check numeric coding used in JAGS
duration_model_df %>%
  count(gender, gender_num)

duration_model_df %>%
  count(round_sound_type, sound_num)

duration_model_df %>%
  count(gender, gender_num, round_sound_type, sound_num)

data_list_duration <- list(
  N = nrow(duration_model_df),
  J = n_distinct(duration_model_df$participant_id),
  y = as.numeric(duration_model_df$log_secs),
  gender = as.integer(duration_model_df$gender_num),
  sound = as.integer(duration_model_df$sound_num),
  participant = as.integer(duration_model_df$participant_id))

str(data_list_duration)

range(data_list_duration$gender)
range(data_list_duration$sound)
range(data_list_duration$participant)

data_list_duration$N
data_list_duration$J

params_duration <- c(
  # Basic coefficients
  "b0",
  "b_gender",
  "b_sound",
  "b_sound_gender",

  # Variance components
  "sigma_participant",
  "sigma",

  # Condition means
  "mean_none_female",
  "mean_alarm_female",
  "mean_cry_female",
  "mean_none_male",
  "mean_alarm_male",
  "mean_cry_male",

  # Within-gender contrasts
  "alarm_vs_none_female",
  "cry_vs_none_female",
  "alarm_vs_cry_female",
  "alarm_vs_none_male",
  "cry_vs_none_male",
  "alarm_vs_cry_male",

  # Gender differences in sound contrasts
  "gender_diff_alarm",
  "gender_diff_cry",
  "gender_diff_alarm_vs_cry",

  # Prior-reference draws
  "b_gender_prior",
  "b_sound_prior",
  "b_sound_gender_prior",

  # Prior-reference contrasts
  "alarm_vs_none_female_prior",
  "cry_vs_none_female_prior",
  "alarm_vs_cry_female_prior",
  "alarm_vs_none_male_prior",
  "cry_vs_none_male_prior",
  "alarm_vs_cry_male_prior",
  "gender_diff_alarm_prior",
  "gender_diff_cry_prior",
  "gender_diff_alarm_vs_cry_prior",
  
  # Posterior predictive check
  "fit_obs",
  "fit_rep",
  "ppc_greater")

```{r}
samples_path_duration <- file.path(results_path, "s2_jags_duration_sound_gender.rds")

if (file.exists(samples_path_duration)) {

  samples_duration <- readRDS(samples_path_duration)

} else {

  samples_duration <- jags.parallel(
    data = data_list_duration,
    inits = NULL,
    parameters.to.save = params_duration,
    model.file = file.path(
      models_path,
      "s2_sound_effect.bugs"),
    n.chains = 12,
    n.iter = 25000,
    n.burnin = 5000,
    n.thin = 1)

  saveRDS(
    samples_duration,
    samples_path_duration)
}

samples_duration
```

```{r}
# Model convergence summary

duration_model_summary <-
  samples_duration$BUGSoutput$summary %>%
  as.data.frame() %>%
  rownames_to_column("parameter")

key_duration_parameters <- c(
  "b0",
  "b_gender",
  "b_sound[2]",
  "b_sound[3]",
  "b_sound_gender[2]",
  "b_sound_gender[3]",
  "sigma_participant",
  "sigma",
  "gender_diff_alarm",
  "gender_diff_cry",
  "gender_diff_alarm_vs_cry")

duration_convergence <- duration_model_summary %>%
  filter(parameter %in% key_duration_parameters) %>%
  dplyr::select(
    parameter,
    mean,
    sd,
    `2.5%`,
    `50%`,
    `97.5%`,
    Rhat,
    n.eff)

duration_convergence

duration_convergence %>%
  summarise(
    max_Rhat = max(Rhat, na.rm = TRUE),
    min_n_eff = min(n.eff, na.rm = TRUE))

duration_model_summary %>%
  summarise(
    max_Rhat = max(Rhat, na.rm = TRUE),
    min_n_eff = min(n.eff, na.rm = TRUE))

duration_model_summary %>%
  filter(Rhat > 1.01) %>%
  arrange(desc(Rhat))
```

prior_post_duration <- bind_rows(

    posterior = s_duration[, "b_gender"],

  tibble(
    parameter = "Alarm versus no sound",
    posterior = s_duration[, "b_sound[2]"],

    parameter = "Infant cry versus no sound",

```{r}
## Extra Bayesian quantities for Table S18 fixed effects
s18_extra <- tibble(
  parameter = c(
    "b_gender",
    "b_sound[2]",
    "b_sound[3]",
    "b_sound_gender[2]",
    "b_sound_gender[3]"),
  prior_parameter = c(
    "b_gender_prior",
    "b_sound_prior[2]",
    "b_sound_prior[3]",
    "b_sound_gender_prior[2]",
    "b_sound_gender_prior[3]")) %>%
  mutate(
    extra = map2(
      parameter,
      prior_parameter,
      function(parameter, prior_parameter) {

        posterior_draws <- s_duration[, parameter]
        prior_draws <- s_duration[, prior_parameter]

        p_positive <- mean(posterior_draws > 0)
        p_negative <- mean(posterior_draws < 0)

        if (p_positive >= p_negative) {
          posterior_probability <- p_positive
          direction <- "> 0"
        } else {
          posterior_probability <- p_negative
          direction <- "< 0"
        }

        ER <- posterior_probability /
          (1 - posterior_probability)

        # Savage-Dickey BF01
        d_post <- density(posterior_draws)
        d_prior <- density(prior_draws)

        post_at_0 <- approx(
          d_post$x,
          d_post$y,
          xout = 0)$y

        prior_at_0 <- approx(
          d_prior$x,
          d_prior$y,
          xout = 0)$y

        BF01 <- post_at_0 / prior_at_0

        tibble(
          direction = direction,
          posterior_probability = posterior_probability,
          ER = ER,
          BF01 = BF01)
      })) %>%
  unnest(extra) %>%
  dplyr::select(
    parameter,
    direction,
    posterior_probability,
    ER,
    BF01)

s18_extra
```

```{r}
# Extra Bayesian quantities for Table S19 gender-difference contrasts
# Bayesian evidence quantities for all Table S19 contrasts

get_bayesian_evidence <- function(
    posterior_draws,
    prior_draws) {

  p_positive <- mean(posterior_draws > 0)
  p_negative <- mean(posterior_draws < 0)

  if (p_positive >= p_negative) {

    posterior_probability <- p_positive
    direction <- "> 0"

  } else {

    posterior_probability <- p_negative
    direction <- "< 0"
  }

  ER <- posterior_probability /
    (1 - posterior_probability)

  # Savage-Dickey BF01
  d_post <- density(posterior_draws)
  d_prior <- density(prior_draws)

  post_at_0 <- approx(
    d_post$x,
    d_post$y,
    xout = 0)$y

  prior_at_0 <- approx(
    d_prior$x,
    d_prior$y,
    xout = 0)$y

  BF01 <- post_at_0 / prior_at_0

  tibble(
    direction = direction,
    posterior_probability = posterior_probability,
    ER = ER,
    BF01 = BF01)
}

s19_evidence <- tibble(
  effect = c(
    "Female: alarm versus no sound",
    "Male: alarm versus no sound",
    "Female-male: alarm versus no sound",

    "Female: infant cry versus no sound",
    "Male: infant cry versus no sound",
    "Female-male: infant cry versus no sound",

    "Female: alarm versus infant cry",
    "Male: alarm versus infant cry",
    "Female-male: alarm versus infant cry"),

  parameter = c(
    "alarm_vs_none_female",
    "alarm_vs_none_male",
    "gender_diff_alarm",

    "cry_vs_none_female",
    "cry_vs_none_male",
    "gender_diff_cry",

    "alarm_vs_cry_female",
    "alarm_vs_cry_male",
    "gender_diff_alarm_vs_cry"),

  prior_parameter = c(
    "alarm_vs_none_female_prior",
    "alarm_vs_none_male_prior",
    "gender_diff_alarm_prior",

    "cry_vs_none_female_prior",
    "cry_vs_none_male_prior",
    "gender_diff_cry_prior",

    "alarm_vs_cry_female_prior",
    "alarm_vs_cry_male_prior",
    "gender_diff_alarm_vs_cry_prior")) %>%
  mutate(
    evidence = map2(
      parameter,
      prior_parameter,
      ~ get_bayesian_evidence(
        posterior_draws = s_duration[, .x],
        prior_draws = s_duration[, .y]))) %>%
  unnest(evidence)

s19_evidence
```

```{r}
table_s19 <- tibble(
  sound_contrast = c(
    "Alarm versus no sound",
    "Infant cry versus no sound",
    "Alarm versus infant cry"),
  female_parameter = c(
    "alarm_vs_none_female",
    "cry_vs_none_female",
    "alarm_vs_cry_female"),
  male_parameter = c(
    "alarm_vs_none_male",
    "cry_vs_none_male",
    "alarm_vs_cry_male"),
  diff_parameter = c(
    "gender_diff_alarm",
    "gender_diff_cry",
    "gender_diff_alarm_vs_cry")) %>%
  left_join(
    duration_model_summary %>%
      transmute(
        female_parameter = parameter,
        female_mean = mean,
        female_lower = `2.5%`,
        female_upper = `97.5%`),
    by = "female_parameter") %>%
  left_join(
    duration_model_summary %>%
      transmute(
        male_parameter = parameter,
        male_mean = mean,
        male_lower = `2.5%`,
        male_upper = `97.5%`),
    by = "male_parameter") %>%
  left_join(
    duration_model_summary %>%
      transmute(
        diff_parameter = parameter,
        diff_mean = mean,
        diff_lower = `2.5%`,
        diff_upper = `97.5%`),
    by = "diff_parameter") %>%
  left_join(
    s19_extra,
    by = "diff_parameter")

    linewidth = 0.55) +

    position = position_jitterdodge(
      jitter.width = 0.07,
      jitter.height = 0,
      dodge.width = 0.78),
    size = 1.7,
    alpha = 0.40) +
  geom_errorbar(
    data = panel_a_summary,
    aes(
      x = round_sound_type,
      ymin = lower,
      ymax = upper,
      colour = gender),
    position = duration_dodge,
    width = 0.10,
    linewidth = 0.9,
    inherit.aes = FALSE) +
  geom_point(
    data = panel_a_summary,
    aes(
      x = round_sound_type,
      y = mean,
      colour = gender),
    position = duration_dodge,
    size = 3.2,
    inherit.aes = FALSE) +
  scale_fill_manual(
    values = gender_colours) +
  scale_colour_manual(
    values = gender_colours) +
  labs(
    title = "A.",
    x = NULL,
    y = "Log-transformed answered-round duration",
    fill = NULL,
    colour = NULL) +
  theme_minimal(base_size = 12) +
  theme(
    panel.grid.minor = element_blank(),
    panel.grid.major.x = element_blank(),
    legend.position = "top")
```

```{r}
panel_b_parameters <- tibble(
  parameter = c(
    "alarm_vs_none_female",
    "cry_vs_none_female",
    "alarm_vs_cry_female",
    "alarm_vs_none_male",
    "cry_vs_none_male",
    "alarm_vs_cry_male"),
  gender = c(
    "Female",
    "Female",
    "Female",
    "Male",
    "Male",
    "Male"),
  contrast = c(
    "Alarm versus no sound",
    "Infant cry versus no sound",
    "Alarm versus infant cry",
    "Alarm versus no sound",
    "Infant cry versus no sound",
    "Alarm versus infant cry"))

panel_b_summary <- panel_b_parameters %>%
  mutate(
    mean = map_dbl(
      parameter,
      ~ mean(s_duration[, .x])),
    lower = map_dbl(
      parameter,
      ~ quantile(
        s_duration[, .x],
        0.025)),
    upper = map_dbl(
      parameter,
      ~ quantile(
        s_duration[, .x],
        0.975)),
    gender = factor(
      gender,
      levels = c("Female", "Male")),
    contrast = factor(
      contrast,
      levels = c(
        "Alarm versus no sound",
        "Infant cry versus no sound",
        "Alarm versus infant cry")))
```

```{r}
p_panel_b <- ggplot(
  panel_b_summary,
  aes(
    x = mean,
    y = contrast,
    colour = gender)) +
  geom_vline(
    xintercept = 0,
    linetype = 2,
    linewidth = 0.7) +
  geom_errorbar(
    aes(
      xmin = lower,
      xmax = upper),
    position = position_dodge(
      width = 0.45),
    width = 0,
    linewidth = 0.9,
    orientation = "y") +
  geom_point(
    position = position_dodge(
      width = 0.45),

  scale_colour_manual(
    values = gender_colours) +
  labs(
    title = "B.",

    y = NULL,
    colour = NULL) +
  theme_minimal(base_size = 12) +
  theme(
    panel.grid.minor = element_blank(),
    panel.grid.major.y = element_blank(),
    legend.position = "none")
```
